urn:csabs:concept/Binary64.axiomBasis: IEEE binary interchange instance: bits=64, radix=2, precision=53, normal exponent range [-1022,1023], gradual underflow, signed zeros, infinities and NaNs. Rounding and flags are explicit environment parameters.
urn:csabs:concept/Binary64.basisScope: Defining interface and selected derived results for the operations listed in this entry. Not an enumeration of all consequences or all alternative foundations.
urn:csabs:concept/Binary64.definition: A 64-bit IEEE binary interchange format with 53 binary significand digits for normal numbers, signed zeros, subnormals, infinities, and NaNs. Rounding mode and arithmetic environment must be supplied separately.
urn:csabs:concept/Binary64.leanModelLimitations: No correctly-rounded arithmetic or exception/NaN payload specification has been proved; run and round are unconstrained client parameters. Not a complete IEEE model.
urn:csabs:concept/Binary64.mathematicalFormulation: The partial format instance has (width,radix,precision,e_min,e_max)=(64,2,53,−1022,1023), with subnormals enabled. Finite nonzero magnitudes are m·2^{e−52}, 0<m<2^{53}, −1022≤e≤1023, and m≥2^{52} unless e=−1022. This instantiates the unconstrained FloatingPointType interface, without an arithmetic-correctness claim.
urn:csabs:concept/Binary64.reviewStatus: editorial basis review; no machine-checked mathematical proof
